messages:
andrew_w: Deploy bot paused the release for redwood-api in prod — values-hash mismatch. Anyone oncall to triage?

deploy-bot: Automated check failed for release redwood-api v2.7.1
release_id: rel-2026-03-05-1123
expected_values_hash: abcdeff1
observed_values_hash: 3f9a8b22
action: PAUSED — manual approval required to continue
link: https://deployments/release/rel-2026-03-05-1123

maya_garcia: 3f9a8b22 looks like the new feature-flag overlay from yesterday. Did CI regenerate values? @liam_k any configbump PRs?

liam_k: I merged infra/global-flags#210 earlier, it updates configmap template. That would change computed hash. We intentionally changed flags for beta customers.

zoe: If the change is intentional we can approve, but we should confirm nothing else drifted. Can someone paste the diff between expected and observed values?

andrew_w: here's a quick diff (sanitized):
```diff
- enable_beta: false
+ enable_beta: true
+ beta_tier: "limited"
```
no other keys changed.

maya_garcia: OK that matches. Thoughts: approve & continue vs rerun release to pick up baked values? Approving will make release use observed values.

liam_k: Prefer to rerun the release after CI publishes new values artifact so deploy record matches. Otherwise auditing will be messy.

andrew_w: Deploy bot allows a one-time override with comment, or we can unpause and re-run. Which is faster for prod?

zoe: Fastest is to unpause and proceed (we verified diffs). But audit wants a note. I'll approve if you add release note and run a smoke check after.

andrew_w: I'll approve then run smoke. Approving now.

deploy-bot: Manual approval received from zoe. ACTION: RESUME RELEASE
command: helm upgrade --install redwood-api ./charts/api --namespace prod --values values-prod.yaml
started: 1796234590

maya_garcia: running smoke checks: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/redwood-api --timeout=2m` and `curl -sS https://prod-api/_health | jq .`

andrew_w: smoke looks green on a few endpoints but 5% of canary hosts 503-ing. :rotating_light: 

liam_k: 503 on hosts behind nginx-frontend; logs show 502 from redwood-api pod. Rolling back to previous revision to be safe.

liam_k: Running: `helm rollback redwood-api 41 --namespace prod` (rev 41 was last known-good)

deploy-bot: Received helm rollback command for redwood-api. Starting rollback...

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. release: redwood-api -> revision 41. Status: SUCCESS. Pods stable.

zoe: Thanks team. Filing a post-release note: we reverted because backend didn't handle new beta flag in time. We'll schedule a small config rollout and patch.

andrew_w: created follow-up ticket ENG-4567 for staged rollout + feature flag gating.

maya_garcia: note for next time: CI should publish values artifact to release record so hashes align. I'll add to ci-playbook.

liam_k: moving to postmortem channel for root cause and checklist updates. closing thread.
